name: Driving-licence retrieval set (Stage 4D)
labelling: Labels were written by Claude from the stored text of tmvr-1989-chap-2 Rules 3-8, 14-18 and neighbouring rules. They are NOT human-reviewed and are separate from eval/telangana-retrieval-benchmark.json, which this set does not modify. 'must_include' means the provision states the answer the question asks for. 'related' means a provision on the same topic that would be acceptable as supporting evidence. 'must_exclude' means retrieving it would be misleading for that question. LIC-011 has no must_include because the retrieval benchmark (TG-PQ-002) accepts any of Rules 14, 16, 17 and 18 for this question.
finding: The stored Telangana corpus has no provision that lists the requirements for getting a driving licence (those are in the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, which are not stored). Rule 6 'Lincensing authority may make enquiries' (sic, as in the source) states only what the licensing authority may check on receiving an application.
